newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - Access poised to tumble.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - Access poised to tumble.

text.p: Access Health Inc's admission last night that it expects fiscal year results to be below the Wall Street consensus estimate put the stock up for sale before Wednesday's market open, setting the stage for a sharp decline, traders said.
Traders said they expect Access to fall to the 17 range from last night's 22-1/2 close.
Before the regular session open, the stock was quoted at 22 bid, 16 ask.

While the company said it expects second quarter earnings to be in-line with analyst forecasts of $0.22 per share, full year fiscal 1997 earnings should be $0.15 to $0.17 below the consensus estimate of $0.99 per share.
It cited slower than anticipated revenue growth for the shortfall.
Toys R Us shares slumped 5/8 to 28 after the company reported fourth quarter earnings this morning of $1.37 per share versus $0.34 one year ago.
According to Zack's Investment Research, the Wall Street consensus estimate for the most recent period was $1.43 per share.
Sales for the quarter rose to $4.7 billion from $4.6 billion.
National Education Corp stock rose 1-1/4 to 18-1/4 before the open on buying related to Sylvan Learning Systems Inc's friendly, $20.37 per share bid for the company.
Sylvan made no moves before the open, traders said.
In other deal-related moves, Ultrak shares were bid at 24-1/2, up from last night's 21-7/8 close.
The gain was driven by Checkpoint Systems Inc's friendly agreement to acquire the company in a stock swap that values Ultrak at about $26.45 per share.
